format.description: RDF/XML and N3 output are deferred to v1.x — the AJV schema rejects them in v0.x.

graph.description: Collapse all quads to this named graph at write time. Required when target emits named graphs and `format` is triple-only (turtle, ntriples).

shapes.description: Path to a SHACL shapes graph (any RDF format). Loaded via src/rdf/Parser.ts, validated by src/shacl/ShaclGate.ts before write.

jsonldContext.description: Compaction context for JSON-LD output. Path string (resolved against config dir), inline object, or omit/'auto' to let squashage build one from the quad set + ctx.prefixes. Rejected by cross-validation when format is not jsonld.

provenance.description: PROV-O sidecar provenance graph configuration (Phase 6 and Phase 7).

enabled.description: When true, provenance quads are emitted for each processed record.

graph.description: Named-graph IRI suffix (resolved against runBase) or a full IRI for the provenance graph.

include.description: Metadata categories to include in provenance output.

encoding.description: Provenance encoding strategy. 'named-graph' (default) emits PROV-O quads into a sidecar named graph. 'rdf-star' emits quoted-triple-subject quads where the rdf:type assertion for each record is the subject of provenance metadata.
